name: animation
description: Makes hand-drawn-style 2D animation as code: the model writes a deterministic renderFrame(t) scene, headless Chromium draws every frame, and ffmpeg encodes the film. The rotoscope skill copies a reference clip drawing by drawing (trace, render through a brush engine, measure each drawing against its source by XOR and SSIM, review at 1:1) and records what it learns so recurring fixes become defaults.
